description: This file is an HTML source for the OpenCart admin report customer order page, including PHP code embedded within it, which generates dynamic report views and handles saving report settings.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class handling the customer order report in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the customer order report form page, set up breadcrumbs, load necessary language and views, and prepare form data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Save the report configuration settings to the database after checking user permissions.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generate and display the customer order report, including status options and results.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Display a list of customer orders report, returning a view with report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieve report data based on request filters and return as a string (HTML view).
